title: Find Winner on a Tic Tac Toe Game
summary: Tic-tac-toe is a game for two players, A and B, who take turns placing 'X' and 'O' in empty squares of a 3x3 grid.
statement: Tic-tac-toe is a game for two players, A and B, who take turns placing 'X' and 'O' in empty squares of a 3x3 grid. Player A always places 'X', while B places 'O'. Moves are made in turns, with no piece placed on a filled square. The game concludes if any row, column, or diagonal is filled with three identical characters or if all squares are filled. If the game ends with a full grid, it's a draw. If moves are still possible, the game is pending. Given a sequence of moves, determine the game's outcome.
constraints: Moves alternate A then B and target empty cells.
Return A, B, Draw, or Pending.
reference_solution:
def tic_tac_toe_result(moves):
 rows=[0]*3;cols=[0]*3;diag=anti=0
 for i,(r,c) in enumerate(moves):
  value=1 if i%2==0 else -1;rows[r]+=value;cols[c]+=value
  if r==c:diag+=value
  if r+c==2:anti+=value
  if 3 in (abs(rows[r]),abs(cols[c]),abs(diag),abs(anti)):return 'A' if value==1 else 'B'
 return 'Draw' if len(moves)==9 else 'Pending'
